name: Trap Bar Shrug
instructions: Stand inside a trap bar and grip the handles, arms straight.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears — don't roll them.
Squeeze hard at the top for a second.
Lower slowly to a full stretch. The neutral grip is easy on the shoulders.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: A beginner minimal-equipment pull-pattern exercise for the upper back. Trap Bar Shrug strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
